profile.headline: Founder of Matrix Numerics & Swift Enthusiast
profile.summary: My experience as the Lead iOS Engineer for SwoopIn brings leadership and excellent programming skills. I myself have a catalog of Apps that have developed from the ground up programmatically in both Swift and Objective-C. My background as a mathematician means I bring exceptional problem solving skills to the table as well as expertise in Machine Learning, Computational Linear Algebra, Image and Signal Processing amongst other related fields. One of my main projects includes a Numerical Methods API for native Mathematical Modeling and Scientific Computing for the Swift programming languages. I am attempting to flatten the learning curve that often comes with using advance numerical Linear Algebra software by bringing this powerful computations to the iOS, MacOS, iPadOS, WatchOS and Linux platforms.

positions.title: Lead iOS Engineer
positions.description: Great Team! Lots of experience and skills are brought to the table by every member on their respective roles. As the Lead Engineer here at SwoopIn, I oversee the development and integration of our platform into iOS. This jobs means you get to work with state-of-the-art APIs and cutting edge technologies in order to seamlessly connect people all over the world. The ever-growing nature of the SwoopIn platform allows for exciting new challenges.
